steps.content:
Buy from **B - Brackmoor Sound** - https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/pnv7ac/b

They are listing the **exact same product**:

> Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones - graphite
> over-ear, closed back, wireless, ANC with transparency mode, up to 40 hours with ANC on, USB-C, Bluetooth 5.3 with two-device pairing, 254g, headphones + carry case + USB-C cable + 3.5mm cable

Everything else is also identical:
* Customer rating: 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)
* In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days
* Returns: 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping.

The only 2 differences are:

**1. Price:**
* A - Ottervale Audio: **$129.00**
* B - Brackmoor Sound: **$161.00**

A is $32 cheaper.

**2. Dealer / Warranty status:**
* A - Ottervale Audio: Just says "1-year limited warranty." No mention of authorized dealer or manufacturer warranty.
* B - Brackmoor Sound: Says **"Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty."** + "1-year limited warranty."

That $32 premium is worth it for headphones like this.

For electronics, manufacturers often will only honor the warranty if you bought from an authorized dealer. B explicitly promises that. A doesn't, so that "1-year limited warranty" may be seller-only, harder to claim, or not honored by Quellwyn at all - a big risk on a $100+ wireless ANC headphone.

Unless you specifically want to self-insure to save 20%, get the authorized one from Brackmoor Sound for the peace of mind.
